insights.concise_text: On the 1,000-tweet dataset, crowdworkers reached 74.7% CCR for entity-level sentiment analysis, while Rosette Text Analytics, Google Cloud, and TensiStrength reached 31.7%, 43.2%, and 44.2%.

triple.subject: crowdworkers
triple.object: Rosette Text Analytics, Google Cloud, and TensiStrength on entity-level sentiment analysis CCR

insights.concise_text: The experiments using correct classification rate (CCR) found entity-level sentiment analysis difficult for existing tools, while recognition of the politician entity was easier.

triple.subject: correct classification rate (CCR) experiments
triple.object: entity-level sentiment analysis difficult and politician entity recognition easier

insights.concise_text: Because existing NLP systems cannot accurately perform sentiment analysis of political tweets and crowdworkers yield well above automated results, future work will use a crowdworker-labeled dataset to train a new machine-learning based NLP system.

triple.subject: existing NLP systems' inaccurate sentiment analysis and crowdworkers' higher accuracy
triple.object: future work using a crowdworker-labeled dataset to train a new machine-learning based NLP system

insights.concise_text: The baseline performance that any new machine learning system for political tweet analysis would compete against was measured as 31.7% for Rosette Text Analytics, 43.2% for Google Cloud, and 44.2% for TensiStrength.
The 3-scale rating of "negative," "neutral," and "positive" corresponds to the three-class sentiment analysis problem whose CCR was 74.7% for crowdworkers.

triple.subject: 3-scale rating of "negative," "neutral," and "positive"
triple.object: three-class sentiment analysis problem with 74.7% CCR for crowdworkers

insights.concise_text: The groundtruth labels considered from experts in political communication contain 210 positive sentiments, 521 neutral sentiments, and 305 negative sentiments to the candidates.

triple.object: 210 positive sentiments, 521 neutral sentiments, and 305 negative sentiments
